user.title: Multimedia setup
user.description: Foundation discovers and selects integrations/devices per multimedia concept first. If no selections exist, create the integration and then configure Screen, Amplifier and Media Sources in RHI Foundation. Next open Multimedia Configure to link rooms, input routes and activities.

data.name: Name
data.confirm: Create Multimedia and configure Foundation first

room.title: Add a Multimedia room
room.description: Choose a Home Assistant area when available. A central device can be used by several rooms.

display.title: Screen / TV
display.description: Select one of the displays already selected in Foundation. Music-only rooms may have no screen.

amplifier.title: Audio / amplifier
amplifier.description: Optional receiver or speaker zone from Foundation. Leave empty if the TV handles audio itself.

sources.title: Media sources
sources.description: Choose the Foundation-selected Apple TV, Shield, console or player used in this room. The same central source can be linked across rooms.

activity.title: Create an activity
activity.description: Choose a standard activity pattern. Multimedia links the logical roles; no physical HDMI connection is inferred.

route.title: Physical input routes
route.description: Confirm the exact input or sound mode exposed by Home Assistant for this device. No guessed HDMI routing.

next.title: Continue
next.description: Add more rooms or activities, or review everything before saving.

review.title: Review and save
review.description: Save only when all linked entities are still approved by Foundation. No device commands are sent during configuration.

error.not_foundation_selected: This device is not in the current Foundation selection.
error.room_requires_av_endpoint: A room requires at least one selected screen, amplifier or source.
error.source_required: Choose a media source selected in Foundation.
error.audio_required: Choose an amplifier or media player for music.
error.activity_exists: An activity with this name already exists.
error.route_changed: The device's available inputs have changed; select a current value.
error.selection_changed: Foundation selection changed or a source disappeared. Review links and retry.
